name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship (CSS) for College and University Students
description: For meritorious students from all categories including General who scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 boards and are pursuing regular undergraduate/postgraduate courses at a recognized institution. Family income must be below INR 8 lakh per year.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: For students studying Class 9 through 12 in government, government-aided, or local body schools. Requires passing a selection test in most states, and family income must not exceed INR 1.5 lakh per year.

name: CBSE Merit Scholarship Scheme for Single Girl Child
deadline: Varies by year, check CBSE website
description: For girls who are the only child of their parents, scored at least 60% in Class 10 CBSE boards, and are continuing into Class 11-12. No family income ceiling.

name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North-Eastern Region Students
description: For students from the eight North-Eastern states pursuing undergraduate studies at institutions across India, with family income up to INR 4.5 lakh per year.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance (varies by course group)
description: For SC students studying beyond Class 10 (Class 11 onward, including diploma, UG, PG, PhD) at recognized institutions in India, with family income up to INR 2.5 lakh per year.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
benefit: Tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance (varies by course group)
description: For ST students studying beyond Class 10 at recognized institutions in India, with family income up to INR 2.5 lakh per year.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC/EBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: INR 5,000 to 20,000/year depending on course group
description: For OBC/EBC students pursuing post-matriculation/post-secondary studies at government-recognized institutions, with family income up to INR 1.5 lakh per year and minimum 75% attendance in the previous class.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
benefit: Tuition fee + maintenance allowance + incidental expenses
description: For students from notified minority communities (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) enrolled in Class 11 onward, with minimum 50% marks in the previous exam and family income up to INR 2 lakh per year. Maximum two students per family.

name: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Professional and Technical Courses (Minorities)
benefit: Course fee up to INR 20,000/year + maintenance allowance INR 1,000-1,200/month
description: For minority students pursuing professional/technical undergraduate and postgraduate courses (engineering, medicine, management, etc.), with family income up to INR 4.5 lakh per year.

name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/DNT students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit: Fully funded — tuition, living expenses, airfare for Master's/PhD abroad
documents_required: Unconditional admission offer from a recognized foreign university
description: Awards ~125 fully funded scholarships annually for Master's and PhD programs abroad. Reserved primarily for SC candidates, with slots for De-notified/Nomadic Tribes and landless agricultural laborers/traditional artisans. 30% of slots reserved for women.

name: PM Scholarship Scheme for Wards of Ex-Servicemen/Armed Forces
description: For wards and widows of ex-servicemen, armed forces personnel, CAPF, and police personnel pursuing professional degree/diploma courses. No income ceiling.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
description: For girl students in the first year (or lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved technical diploma or degree program, with family income up to INR 8 lakh per year. Limited to 2 girls per family.
